translate_en|mods/WorldDecay/42/media/lu: Cosmetic section divider. Does nothing. Turning a feature off here skips it entirely during generation, rather than just setting its percentage to 0 -- use this for features you never want so the mod doesn't spend any time on them.
Cosmetic section divider. These options place real vegetation objects with depth and occlusion; they are more expensive than overlays.
Cosmetic section divider. These options control flat decals on natural ground, roads, indoor floors, and roofs.
Overall chance that an eligible exterior window or door receives a barricade. The material controls below affect windows; doors use the vanilla random material selection.
Chance that the battery is damaged.
How many bushes spawn on road tiles.
How many bushes spawn on roof tiles (Z > 1).
How many custom bushes and hedges spawn on natural ground.
How much custom grass and debris spawns on road tiles.
Approximate chance for custom flat vegetation overlays on natural ground. Separate from Leaf and Ground Debris Overlay Density.
Enables detailed logging to the console. Only useful for troubleshooting or mod development.
How many exterior doors are destroyed.
How many cracked overlays appear on natural ground tiles.
Chance that a door is damaged.
If disabled, the barricade generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the barricade percentage below.
If disabled, the bush generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the bush percentages below.
If disabled, the destroyed-doors-and-windows generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the percentages below.
If disabled, the fence decay generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the fence percentages below.
If disabled, the grass-object generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the grass-object percentages below.
If disabled, floor tile overlays (grass, leaves, debris, trash, cracks) are skipped entirely, regardless of the overlay percentages below.
If disabled, the tree generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the tree percentages below.
If disabled, the vine generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the vine percentage below.
If disabled, the wall decay generator is skipped entirely, regardless of the wall percentage below.
Chance that the engine is damaged.
Reduced version of Time Budget used while driving above the Fast Travel Speed.
High-priority bubble while driving fast. Values above Fast Travel Scan Radius are clamped.
How often periodic scans run for a fast-driving player. Lower values update nearby chunks sooner but use more CPU.
Periodic scan coverage while driving fast. Values above normal Scan Radius are clamped.
Vehicle speed above which the mod switches to the Fast Travel Time Budget to reduce stutter while driving. 0 disables this.
Override chance for multi-tile bendable fences (tall chainlink, metal dividers, tall wood). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
How severely bent fences become. Random picks any stage equally. Light always stage 1, Medium stage 2, Heavy stage 3.
Override chance for single-tile breakable fences (wood, metal bars, short chainlink). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
When a breakable fence is damaged, the chance (weight) it gets fully destroyed vs partially damaged. Higher = more destruction.
Base chance for fences to be damaged. Used as fallback when Break Chance or Bend Chance is set to 0.
How many dead leaves cover the ground on road tiles.
How many dead leaves cover the ground on natural tiles.
Maximum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Minimum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Chance that the gas tank is damaged.
Chance the gas tank is missing.
Chance per part that the general condition is applied.
Base condition applied to ALL parts (100 = full condition). Individual settings apply on top.
Maximum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Minimum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Chance that the glove box is damaged.
Chance the glove box is missing.
Approximate chance for a valid flat vegetation overlay on road tiles. Separate from Grass Object Density (Road) and has no depth.
Approximate chance for a valid flat vegetation overlay on natural ground. Separate from Grass Object Density below; overlays have no depth and do not block movement.
How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on road tiles.
How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on natural ground.
Chance that a headlight is damaged.
Chance that the heater is damaged.
Chance that the hood is damaged.
How many bushes spawn inside buildings on floor tiles.
How much grass and overgrowth spawns as a real object (has depth) inside buildings on floor tiles.
How many cracked floor overlays appear inside buildings.
How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
How much ground debris appears as flat floor decals inside buildings.
How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
How many leaf decals appear on indoor floors.
How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Chance for generated trees to use Jumbo XL or Jumbo XXL sprites.
Relative material weight for generated window barricades. 100/100 gives an even wood/metal split; 0 disables metal barricades. The overall spawn rate is controlled by Barricade Percentage.
If enabled, vines also grow on upper floor walls. Disabled by default.
How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on road tiles. Separate from the Grass Overlay (Road) option above.
How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on natural ground. Separate from the Grass Overlay option above - both can spawn on the same tile.
Progressive mode only: in-game days until decay reaches 100%% of the configured sandbox percentages. 365 = one year.
Progressive mode only: fraction of the configured percentages already present at world start. 0 = pristine world, 25 = the world starts with a quarter of the configured decay.
Chance that the radio is damaged.
How often each player's nearby completed chunks are checked for re-decay. Higher values delay re-decay checks and reduce scan work.

If enabled, chunks processed long ago receive additional decay passes as the world ages, applying only the percentage gained since the last pass. Without this, decay is applied once per chunk forever.
Minimum in-game days between decay passes on the same chunk.
If enabled, re-decay also repeats walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades, and vines. If disabled, re-decay only adds vegetation.
How many cracked overlays appear on road tiles.
How far road-grass patches can spread from natural ground. Higher values reach farther from road edges and do a few more checks per processed chunk.

If enabled, road grass can form in any eligible road area and concentrates in lush Vegetation Region Scale patches. If disabled, road grass only begins near natural ground as before. Requires Vegetation Region Scale to be enabled.
How much seasonal grass spawns as a real object on roof tiles (Z > 1). Objects have depth and can be walked behind.
How many cracked overlays appear on rooftops.
How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
How much ground debris appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
How many leaf decals appear on rooftops.
How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
How many roofs on upper floors are destroyed, with 80%% chance of replacing with a destroyed variant.
How often the mod scans for new chunks around each player. Lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage.
Normal-speed high-priority bubble for periodic scans. Values above Scan Radius are clamped to Scan Radius.
How many chunks away from the player are scanned for processing. Higher = more area covered but more chunks queued at once.
If enabled, generated vegetation follows the season: grass density is reduced in winter, lusher in summer, and leaves increase in autumn. Vegetation objects also update their seasonal appearance.
If enabled, world age also increases decay intensity, not just probability: vehicle parts spawn in worse condition and are missing more often, and damaged fences are destroyed more often.
Chance that a taillight is damaged.
Maximum milliseconds per frame for world generation. Lower = smoother FPS but slower generation. Higher = faster generation but possible lag spikes.
Shape of the multiplier growth over time. Linear: steady. Logarithmic: fast early, saturates later. Quadratic: slow early, aggressive in old worlds.
If enabled, decay percentages increase the older the world is. Newly explored chunks in long-running worlds look more decayed.
If enabled, the multiplier follows the vanilla Erosion Speed (days until full erosion) instead of the per-year rate: it reaches the Maximum Multiplier when vanilla erosion reaches 100%%.
Upper cap for the world-age decay multiplier. 4.0 means decay percentages can grow up to 4x their configured values.

Amplify: configured percentages apply fully from day one and grow up to the cap. Progressive: decay starts near zero and gradually ramps up to the configured percentages over the configured number of days, then keeps growing up to the cap. Combine Progressive with Incremental Re-Decay so already explored areas fill in over time.
How strongly world-age scaling affects vegetation (trees, bushes, grass, vines, ground overlays). 100 = base speed, 150 = nature reclaims 50%% faster, 0 = no scaling for nature.
How much all decay percentages increase per in-game year of world age. 25 means +25%% relative increase per year, capped by the Maximum Multiplier.
How strongly world-age scaling affects structural decay (walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades). 100 = base speed, lower values make buildings decay slower than nature grows.
How strongly world-age scaling affects vehicle deterioration when Severity Scaling is enabled. 100 = base speed.
Chance that a tire is damaged.
How much decorative trash appears on roads and streets.
How much decorative trash (non-lootable) scatters on the ground.
Relative chance for American Holly (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Relative chance for American Linden trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Relative chance for Canadian Hemlock (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Relative chance for Dogwood trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
How many trees spawn on roads and pavement.
How many trees with random foliage spawn on natural ground.
Relative chance for Red Maple trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Relative chance for River Birch trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Relative chance for Virginia Pine (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Chance that the trunk is damaged.
Smooth makes gentle density changes. Patchy creates deterministic barren, sparse, normal, and lush regions while preserving the approximate average density.
Size of deterministic Voronoi vegetation regions. Existing density percentages remain the world-wide average.
Maximum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Minimum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Master switch. Disable to prevent any vehicle deterioration from this mod.
How often abandoned, rusted vehicles with blood stains spawn on roads.
Maximum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Minimum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
How much ivy and vines grow on exterior walls and fences.
If enabled, vines only grow on exterior squares. Disable to allow vines inside buildings. Enabled by default.
If enabled, vines grow on fences and railings. Disable to prevent vines on fences.
If enabled, vines grow on exterior walls. Disable to prevent vines on building walls.
How many exterior wooden walls are replaced with burnt/damaged variants. Excludes doors and windows.
Chance that a window is damaged.
Relative material weight for generated window barricades. 100/100 gives an even wood/metal split; 0 disables wooden barricades. The overall spawn rate is controlled by Barricade Percentage.
translate_en|mods/WorldDecay_RustRemover: Timed-action duration at Mechanics level 0. The default 600 is a deliberately slow 10-minute treatment.
The percentage drained from a Rust Remover bottle for each treatment.
Allow players to remove visual vehicle rust using Rust Remover and Sandpaper.
How much each Mechanics level shortens treatment time. Total reduction is capped at 50%%.
The percentage of a vehicle's visual rust removed by one completed treatment.
The percentage of a Sandpaper sheet's maximum condition lost per treatment.
